svg.aria-label: The search for the ceiling drawn as four runs on a number line. One thousand users passes, two thousand passes, three thousand fails, and an arc doubles back to two thousand five hundred, which passes and is the ceiling. Labels mark the first three as doubling until it breaks and the last as halving the gap. The caption says four runs rather than forty, and that the failing run is the most informative one, so a search that never fails has never found the edge.
svg.text: SEARCH FOR THE CEILING, DO NOT CREEP UP ON IT
